about: Tuned llama-server settings per model and route, applied by `1bit serve` (docs/recipes.md). A recipe never overrides a flag already on the backend's command line or a variable already set. Every recipe carries the measurement behind it; re-measure with tools/bench.py before changing one.

recipes.why: A DFlash block is only worth drafting whole. Our HRX llama.cpp defaults to p-min 0 already (common.h), so this pins it there whatever a backend's default; the removed ROCm tree defaulted to 0.75 and cut blocks short.
recipes.measured: Qwen3.8-27B-H32 + DFlash2 on the lean ROCm route (removed in RFC #213 stage 3): mean accepted block 5.4 -> 6.7 tokens on code. Not yet re-measured on HRX.
